verified_from_google_maps.website_note: Google Maps shows an 'Add website' action, meaning no website is listed.
verified_from_google_maps.business_claimed_note: A 'Claim this business' link is present in the Maps data.

food_mentioned_in_reviews: Sunday carvery / roast beef and turkey
third_party_only_not_verified.space_layout_note: Reviews and a Dublin pub guide describe three areas: the front bar, a long lounge, and an upstairs room/function space. Open-plan feel, traditional decor, a large fireplace.
third_party_only_not_verified.price_note: Directories show EUR 10-20 per person; one older source mentions a EUR 50 two-course deal that is no longer available - do not publish any prices without confirmation.

conflicts_and_cautions.old_phone: Tripadvisor lists +353 1 831 1261. Google Maps and current directories list +353 1 832 7311 - use the latter.
conflicts_and_cautions.expired_domain: thegobletpub.com appears in some directories but DNS returns NXDOMAIN (does not resolve). RestaurantGuru's Instagram field literally reads '@expireddomainscom'. Treat as a dead domain - do not link to it.
conflicts_and_cautions.hours_variants: Some directories say 10:00 or 12:00 Sunday opening. Use the Google Maps hours above.
conflicts_and_cautions.negative_review_themes: Dated decor, inconsistent service, unclear allergen information, isolated overcharging complaints. Do not make allergen or accessibility claims beyond the four verified Google Maps accessibility attributes.

opportunity: No live website and apparently unclaimed Google Business Profile. A new site can own the brand search result, publish verified hours/phone/address, and surface the strongest differentiators (Guinness, Sunday carvery, live music, three distinct spaces, free parking, full wheelchair access).
local_context: Same Dublin 5 / Artane / Beaumont area as the Ume Nail Studio project (6 Ardscollum Ave). 'The Roundabout' pub at 2 Ardcollum Avenue is about 450 m away and is the closest neighbouring pub.
needed_before_build: Real photos (exterior, bar, lounge, upstairs, carvery/food, pint) - originals into assets/photos/
Confirmation of opening hours, food service times and whether a current menu exists
